test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated user cannot access the Financial Years page
test_cases.steps:
1. Open a browser with no active session.
2. Navigate directly to the Financial Years page URL.
test_cases.expected: The user is redirected to the login page. No financial year data is visible.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user with view permission can access the Financial Years page
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in with a valid account.
2. Navigate to Planning > Financial Years from the main menu.
test_cases.expected: The Financial Years page loads. The eyebrow reads 'Planning', the title reads 'Financial Years', and the subtitle reads 'Manage financial year periods and their lifecycle status.'

test_cases.scenario: Add Financial Year button is visible for users with create permission
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a user with financial year create permission.
2. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
test_cases.expected: The 'Add Financial Year' button is visible in the page header actions area.

test_cases.scenario: Add Financial Year button is not visible for read-only users
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a user with read-only access.
2. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
test_cases.expected: The 'Add Financial Year' button is not present.

test_cases.scenario: Edit, Toggle Active, Set Active, and Delete actions are hidden for read-only users
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a read-only user.
2. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
3. Observe the row actions.
test_cases.expected: No Edit, Toggle Active, Set Active, or Delete action buttons appear on any financial year row.

test_cases.scenario: Users with change permission see Edit, Toggle Active, and Set Active actions
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a user with change permission.
2. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
test_cases.expected: Edit, Toggle Active, and Set Active action buttons are visible on applicable rows.

test_cases.scenario: Users with delete permission see the Delete action
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a user with delete permission.
2. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
test_cases.expected: The Delete action button is visible on financial year rows.

test_cases.scenario: View drawer Edit button is hidden for read-only users
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a read-only user.
2. Click a financial year row to open the view drawer.
test_cases.expected: The view drawer opens showing the financial year details. The 'Edit Financial Year' button is not shown in the footer — only 'Close' is visible.

test_cases.scenario: Breadcrumb reflects Planning > Financial Years hierarchy
test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
test_cases.expected: The breadcrumb trail correctly shows the path to Financial Years under the Planning section.

test_cases.scenario: Financial year records load and display in the table on page open
test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
test_cases.expected: All existing financial year records are displayed in the table without errors.

test_cases.scenario: Table displays the correct columns on desktop
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page on a desktop viewport.
2. Observe the column headers.
test_cases.expected: Columns appear in order: Financial Year, Short, Code, Start Date, End Date, Span (Days), Status, Active, Created.

test_cases.scenario: Search field filters records by financial year name
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Type part of a financial year name or code into the search field.
test_cases.expected: The table updates to show only financial year records matching the search term.

test_cases.scenario: Search with no matching results shows an empty state
test_cases.steps: 1. Type a search term that does not match any financial year.
test_cases.expected: The table shows 'No financial years found.' with no data rows.

test_cases.scenario: Clearing the search field restores the full list
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply a search term that filters results.
2. Clear the search field.
test_cases.expected: The full list of financial years is restored with no search filter active.

test_cases.scenario: FY Status filter shows only financial years with the selected status
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the Status filter dropdown.
2. Select a specific FY status (e.g. 'In Progress').
test_cases.expected: The table updates to show only financial years with that status. Records with other statuses are hidden.

test_cases.scenario: Is Active filter set to Active shows only active financial years
test_cases.steps: 1. Click the Active filter and select 'Active'.
test_cases.expected: The table shows only financial year records where is_active is true.

test_cases.scenario: Is Active filter set to Inactive shows only inactive financial years
test_cases.steps: 1. Click the Active filter and select 'Inactive'.
test_cases.expected: The table shows only financial year records where is_active is false.

test_cases.scenario: Is Active filter set to All shows all financial years regardless of active state
test_cases.steps: 1. Set the Active filter to 'All'.
test_cases.expected: Both active and inactive financial years are displayed.

test_cases.scenario: Multiple filters can be combined
test_cases.steps:
1. Type a search term.
2. Select a FY Status.
3. Set Is Active to 'Active'.
test_cases.expected: The table shows only records that match all three criteria simultaneously.

test_cases.scenario: Active filter chips appear when filters are applied
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply the FY Status filter.
2. Apply the Is Active filter.
test_cases.expected: Active filter chips or tags are shown for each applied filter. Clicking a chip removes that filter.

test_cases.scenario: Table can be sorted by Financial Year column
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the Financial Year column header.
2. Click it again.
test_cases.expected: First click sorts alphabetically ascending. Second click reverses to descending.

test_cases.scenario: Table can be sorted by Start Date ascending and descending
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the Start Date column header once.
2. Click it again.
test_cases.expected: Records sort from earliest to latest start date, then reverse.

test_cases.scenario: Table can be sorted by End Date ascending and descending
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the End Date column header once.
2. Click it again.
test_cases.expected: Records sort from earliest to latest end date, then reverse.

test_cases.scenario: Table can be sorted by Span (Days)
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the Span (Days) column header once.
2. Click it again.
test_cases.expected: Records sort from shortest to longest span in days, then reverse.

test_cases.scenario: Table can be sorted by Created date
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the Created column header once.
2. Click it again.
test_cases.expected: Records sort by creation date ascending, then descending.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking a financial year row opens the view drawer
test_cases.steps: 1. Click anywhere on a financial year row, not on an action button.
test_cases.expected: The view drawer slides open showing the full details of the selected financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Pagination controls navigate between pages when many records exist
test_cases.steps:
1. Ensure more than 25 financial year records exist.
2. Use the next and previous page controls.
test_cases.expected: Page navigation works correctly. The correct subset of records is shown on each page.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking Add Financial Year opens the create drawer
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Click the 'Add Financial Year' button.
test_cases.expected: The create drawer slides open with a blank form. The drawer title reads 'Create Financial Year'.

test_cases.scenario: Create drawer contains the expected form fields
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Observe the form fields.
test_cases.expected: The form contains: Start Date (required), End Date (required), and Note (optional).

test_cases.scenario: A financial year is created successfully with Start Date and End Date
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Set a Start Date.
3. Set an End Date after the Start Date.
4. Click 'Create Financial Year'.
test_cases.expected: The drawer closes. A success toast appears. The new financial year appears in the table with auto-generated Financial Year name, Short form, Code, and Span (Days) values.

test_cases.scenario: Financial Year name, Short form, Code, and Span are auto-generated from the dates
test_cases.steps:
1. Create a financial year with a Start Date of 1 April 2025 and End Date of 31 March 2026.
2. View the created record in the table.
test_cases.expected: The Financial Year, Short, Code, and Span (Days) columns are populated automatically based on the dates entered. The user does not need to enter these manually.

test_cases.scenario: Start Date is required — validation error shown when empty
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Set an End Date but leave Start Date empty.
3. Click 'Create Financial Year'.
test_cases.expected: The form does not submit. A validation error appears under Start Date indicating it is required.

test_cases.scenario: End Date is required — validation error shown when empty
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Set a Start Date but leave End Date empty.
3. Click 'Create Financial Year'.
test_cases.expected: The form does not submit. A validation error appears under End Date indicating it is required.

test_cases.scenario: End Date set before Start Date shows a validation error
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Set Start Date to 1 April 2025.
3. Set End Date to 1 January 2025 (before Start Date).
4. Click 'Create Financial Year'.
test_cases.expected: A validation error is shown indicating the End Date must be after the Start Date. The financial year is not created.

test_cases.scenario: Note field is optional — form submits successfully without a note
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Set Start Date and End Date.
3. Leave the Note field empty.
4. Click 'Create Financial Year'.
test_cases.expected: The financial year is created successfully without a note.

test_cases.scenario: Note can be added during financial year creation
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Set Start Date and End Date.
3. Enter a note.
4. Click 'Create Financial Year'.
test_cases.expected: The financial year is created. The note is saved and visible in the view drawer.

test_cases.scenario: Closing the create drawer without submitting discards all entered data
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Enter Start Date and End Date.
3. Click Cancel without submitting.
test_cases.expected: The drawer closes. No financial year is created. The form is blank when reopened.

test_cases.scenario: Submit button shows a busy/loading state during creation
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Fill in required fields.
3. Click 'Create Financial Year' and observe the button immediately.
test_cases.expected: The button shows a loading indicator and becomes non-clickable while the request processes.

test_cases.scenario: Success toast appears and drawer closes after creating a financial year
test_cases.steps: 1. Create a financial year with valid dates and submit.
test_cases.expected: The drawer closes automatically. A success toast notification appears confirming the financial year was created.

test_cases.scenario: Start Date and End Date fields are shown side by side in the create drawer
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer on a desktop viewport.
2. Observe the layout of the date fields.
test_cases.expected: Start Date and End Date appear side by side (two columns) in the create drawer.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking a financial year row opens the view drawer
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Click anywhere on a financial year row (not on an action button).
test_cases.expected: The view drawer slides open showing the full details of the selected financial year.

test_cases.scenario: View drawer displays all expected detail fields
test_cases.steps:
1. Click on a financial year row.
2. Observe all fields shown in the view drawer.
test_cases.expected: The view drawer shows: Financial Year (Long), Financial Year (Short), Code (code style), Start Date, End Date, Span (Days), Status, Note (description style), Created (meta), Created by (meta).

test_cases.scenario: Code field is rendered in monospace/code style
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the view drawer for any financial year.
2. Observe the Code field.
test_cases.expected: The Code is displayed in a monospace or code-styled format, visually distinct from regular text.

test_cases.scenario: Status field shows the correct FY lifecycle status
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the view drawer for a financial year.
2. Observe the Status field.
test_cases.expected: The Status field shows the correct lifecycle status (e.g. Planned, In Progress, or Closed) for the selected financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Note field is blank or empty for financial years created without a note
test_cases.steps:
1. Create a financial year without a note.
2. Open the view drawer for that record.
test_cases.expected: The Note field is empty or shows a placeholder. No error is displayed.

test_cases.scenario: Span (Days) shows the correct number of days between Start and End Date
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the view drawer for a financial year with known start and end dates.
2. Check the Span (Days) field.
test_cases.expected: The Span (Days) value accurately represents the total number of days in the financial year period.

test_cases.scenario: Created and Created by metadata fields show accurate values
test_cases.steps:
1. Create a new financial year.
2. Open the view drawer for it.
3. Check the Created and Created by fields.
test_cases.expected: Created shows the date and time the record was created. Created by shows the username of the creator.

test_cases.scenario: Edit Financial Year button in the view drawer footer opens the edit drawer
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the view drawer (as a user with change permission).
2. Click 'Edit Financial Year' in the footer.
test_cases.expected: The view drawer closes and the edit drawer opens, pre-populated with the financial year's current data.

test_cases.scenario: Close button in the view drawer footer closes it without changes
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the view drawer for a financial year.
2. Click 'Close'.
test_cases.expected: The view drawer closes. No changes are made and the user is returned to the financial years list.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking the Edit action opens the edit drawer pre-populated
test_cases.steps: 1. Click the Edit action button on a financial year row.
test_cases.expected: The edit drawer opens. The Financial Year (Long) and Short Form fields are shown as read-only. Start Date, End Date, and Note are pre-filled with current values.

test_cases.scenario: Financial Year (Long) and Short Form fields are read-only in the edit drawer
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer for any financial year.
2. Observe the Financial Year and Short Form fields at the top of the form.
test_cases.expected: Both the Financial Year (Long) and Short Form fields are displayed as non-editable view fields. They cannot be changed manually — they are auto-generated from the dates.

test_cases.scenario: Start Date can be updated and saved successfully
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer for a financial year.
2. Change the Start Date to a different valid date.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: The drawer closes. A success toast appears. The updated Start Date is reflected in the table. The auto-generated Financial Year name, Short form, and Span also update to reflect the new dates.

test_cases.scenario: End Date can be updated and saved successfully
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer for a financial year.
2. Change the End Date.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: The drawer closes. A success toast appears. The End Date and auto-derived fields (Span) update in the table.

test_cases.scenario: Clearing Start Date shows a validation error and prevents saving
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer.
2. Clear the Start Date field.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: An inline error appears under Start Date. The drawer does not close and the change is not saved.

test_cases.scenario: Clearing End Date shows a validation error and prevents saving
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer.
2. Clear the End Date field.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: An inline error appears under End Date. The change is not saved.

test_cases.scenario: Setting End Date before Start Date in edit mode shows a validation error
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer.
2. Set End Date to a date before the Start Date.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: A validation error is shown indicating the date range is invalid. The change is not saved.

test_cases.scenario: Note can be added to a financial year that had no note
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer for a financial year with no note.
2. Enter a note.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: The note is saved. The view drawer for that financial year now shows the note.

test_cases.scenario: Note can be cleared from an existing financial year
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer for a financial year that has a note.
2. Delete all text from the Note field.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: The note is removed. The view drawer shows no note for that record.

test_cases.scenario: Closing the edit drawer without saving discards all changes
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the edit drawer.
2. Change the Start Date.
3. Click Cancel.
test_cases.expected: The drawer closes. The financial year in the table shows its original unchanged values.

test_cases.scenario: Success toast appears after successfully saving edits
test_cases.steps: 1. Open the edit drawer, make a valid change, and click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: A success toast notification appears confirming the financial year was updated.

test_cases.scenario: Toggle Active action on an active financial year shows a deactivate confirmation modal
test_cases.steps:
1. Find an active financial year (Active column shows active/true).
2. Click the Toggle Active action.
test_cases.expected: A deactivation confirmation modal appears asking the user to confirm deactivating the financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Toggle Active action on an inactive financial year shows an activate confirmation modal
test_cases.steps:
1. Find an inactive financial year.
2. Click the Toggle Active action.
test_cases.expected: An activation confirmation modal appears asking the user to confirm activating the financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Confirming deactivation marks the financial year as inactive
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Toggle Active on an active financial year.
2. Confirm deactivation in the modal.
test_cases.expected: The modal closes. The financial year's Active column updates to show inactive. A success toast confirms the change.

test_cases.scenario: Confirming activation marks the financial year as active
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Toggle Active on an inactive financial year.
2. Confirm activation in the modal.
test_cases.expected: The modal closes. The financial year's Active column updates to show active. A success toast confirms the change.

test_cases.scenario: Cancelling the activate/deactivate modal leaves the state unchanged
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Toggle Active on any financial year.
2. Click Cancel in the confirmation modal.
test_cases.expected: The modal closes. The financial year's active state is unchanged.

test_cases.scenario: Inactive financial years can be filtered out using the Is Active filter
test_cases.steps:
1. Deactivate a financial year.
2. Set the Is Active filter to 'Active'.
test_cases.expected: The deactivated financial year does not appear in the filtered results.

test_cases.scenario: Set Active action is visible for financial years not currently in progress
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Find a financial year that is NOT marked as in progress.
3. Observe the available row actions.
test_cases.expected: The 'Set Active' action button is visible for that financial year row.

test_cases.scenario: Set Active action is hidden for financial years already in progress
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Find a financial year that is already marked as in progress.
3. Observe the available row actions.
test_cases.expected: The 'Set Active' action is not visible for the in-progress financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking Set Active on a financial year marks it as the current/in-progress period
test_cases.steps:
1. Click the 'Set Active' action on a financial year that is not currently in progress.
2. Confirm the action if prompted.
test_cases.expected: The financial year's Status updates to 'In Progress' (or equivalent). A success toast confirms the change. The Set Active action is no longer visible for this record.

test_cases.scenario: Only one financial year can be in progress at a time
test_cases.steps:
1. Note which financial year is currently in progress.
2. Click Set Active on a different financial year.
3. Confirm the change.
test_cases.expected: The new financial year becomes 'In Progress'. The previously in-progress financial year's status updates accordingly (e.g. Closed or Planned). Only one financial year is in progress at any time.

test_cases.scenario: Financial year set as active is visible in relevant planning views
test_cases.steps:
1. Set a specific financial year as active.
2. Navigate to planning pages that display the current financial year.
test_cases.expected: The newly activated financial year is reflected as the current period in relevant planning and capacity views.

test_cases.scenario: FY Status filter shows In Progress financial years correctly
test_cases.steps:
1. Set a financial year as active (In Progress).
2. Apply the FY Status filter and select 'In Progress'.
test_cases.expected: The table shows only the financial year(s) currently marked as in progress.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking Delete shows a confirmation modal
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Click the Delete action button on a financial year row.
test_cases.expected: A delete confirmation modal appears referencing the selected financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Confirming deletion permanently removes the financial year
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Delete on a financial year.
2. Type the required confirmation text.
3. Click the confirm delete button.
test_cases.expected: The modal closes. The financial year is removed from the table. A success toast confirms the deletion.

test_cases.scenario: Delete confirm button is disabled until correct confirmation text is typed
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Delete on a financial year.
2. Leave the confirmation field empty or type incorrect text.
test_cases.expected: The confirm delete button is disabled and cannot be clicked until the exact required text is entered.

test_cases.scenario: Cancelling the delete modal keeps the financial year intact
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Delete on a financial year.
2. Click Cancel in the confirmation modal.
test_cases.expected: The modal closes. The financial year remains in the table unchanged.

test_cases.scenario: Delete confirmation modal warns that the action is permanent
test_cases.steps:
1. Click Delete on any financial year.
2. Read the modal body text.
test_cases.expected: The modal clearly warns that deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

test_cases.scenario: Import button is visible on the Financial Years page
test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to the Financial Years page with manage permissions.
test_cases.expected: An Import button is visible in the page header actions area.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking Import opens the import view
test_cases.steps: 1. Click the Import button.
test_cases.expected: The import view opens with options to download a sample file and upload a file.

test_cases.scenario: Sample import file can be downloaded
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the import view.
2. Click the sample file download link.
test_cases.expected: A sample CSV file is downloaded with the expected import columns (start_date, end_date, note).

test_cases.scenario: A valid CSV of financial year records imports successfully
test_cases.steps:
1. Prepare a valid CSV with start_date and end_date columns.
2. Upload it in the import view and confirm.
test_cases.expected: The import completes. A success message shows the number of records imported. The table refreshes and shows the new financial years.

test_cases.scenario: Uploading an invalid file format is rejected
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the import view.
2. Attempt to upload a .xlsx, .pdf, or image file.
test_cases.expected: The import view rejects the file and shows an error message.

test_cases.scenario: Importing a row where End Date is before Start Date shows a row-level error
test_cases.steps:
1. Prepare a CSV with a row where end_date is before start_date.
2. Import it.
test_cases.expected: The import reports a validation error for that row. The row is not imported.

test_cases.scenario: Table refreshes automatically after a successful import
test_cases.steps: 1. Import a valid CSV with new financial year records.
test_cases.expected: The table refreshes and shows the newly imported financial years without requiring a manual page reload.

test_cases.scenario: Export button is visible on the Financial Years page
test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to the Financial Years page with manage permissions.
test_cases.expected: An Export button is visible in the page header actions area.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking Export opens the export view
test_cases.steps: 1. Click the Export button.
test_cases.expected: The export configuration panel opens.

test_cases.scenario: Financial years can be exported and a file is downloaded
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the export view.
2. Configure and initiate the export.
test_cases.expected: A file is downloaded to the user's device containing financial year data.

test_cases.scenario: Exported file contains expected columns
test_cases.steps:
1. Export all financial years.
2. Open the downloaded file.
test_cases.expected: The exported file contains at minimum: Financial Year, Short, Code, Start Date, End Date, Span (Days), Status, Active.

test_cases.scenario: Export respects active filters
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply the FY Status filter to show only 'In Progress' records.
2. Export.
test_cases.expected: The exported file contains only financial years with the filtered status, not all records.

test_cases.scenario: Export view can be closed without exporting
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the export view.
2. Close it without initiating a download.
test_cases.expected: The export view closes. No file is downloaded and no data changes.

test_cases.scenario: All interactive elements on the Financial Years page are keyboard accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Use only Tab and Enter/Space to reach and activate all controls.
test_cases.expected: All buttons, filters, table rows, and row actions are reachable and operable by keyboard.

test_cases.scenario: Full financial year creation can be completed via keyboard only
test_cases.steps:
1. Use keyboard to open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Tab through Start Date, End Date, and Note.
3. Submit via keyboard.
test_cases.expected: The financial year is created successfully without using the mouse.

test_cases.scenario: Focus is trapped within open drawers
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer.
2. Press Tab repeatedly.
test_cases.expected: Focus cycles within the drawer and does not escape to the main page behind.

test_cases.scenario: Validation error messages are clear and descriptive
test_cases.steps:
1. Submit the create form with both date fields empty.
2. Read the error messages.
test_cases.expected: Each validation message is human-readable and clearly states what the user must provide.

test_cases.scenario: No internal error details or stack traces are shown to the user
test_cases.steps:
1. Trigger error conditions on the Financial Years page.
2. Observe all error messages.
test_cases.expected: All error messages are user-friendly and do not expose stack traces, database errors, or internal server details.

test_cases.scenario: Session expiry prevents creating or editing financial years
test_cases.steps:
1. Allow the session to expire.
2. Attempt to create or edit a financial year.
test_cases.expected: The user is redirected to the login page. No data changes are made.

test_cases.scenario: Page renders correctly in dark theme
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to the Financial Years page.
2. Toggle to dark theme.
test_cases.expected: All elements — table, filters, drawers, modals, and toasts — render correctly in dark mode without visual breakage.

test_cases.scenario: Financial Years page loads within an acceptable time
test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to the Financial Years page on a standard connection.
test_cases.expected: The page and data load within a reasonable time (typically under 3 seconds).

test_cases.scenario: All table columns are visible on desktop viewports
test_cases.steps: 1. Open the Financial Years page on a desktop browser (viewport ≥ 1024px).
test_cases.expected: All columns are visible: Financial Year, Short, Code, Start Date, End Date, Span (Days), Status, Active, Created.

test_cases.scenario: Search, FY Status, and Is Active filters are displayed in the filter bar on desktop
test_cases.steps: 1. View the Financial Years page on a desktop viewport.
test_cases.expected: All three filters (Search, Status, Active) are displayed inline in a horizontal filter bar above the table.

test_cases.scenario: Start Date and End Date fields appear side by side in the create drawer on desktop
test_cases.steps: 1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer on a desktop viewport.
test_cases.expected: Start Date and End Date are displayed side by side (two columns) in the drawer.

test_cases.scenario: Drawers open as a side panel on desktop
test_cases.steps: 1. Open any drawer (create, edit, or view) on desktop.
test_cases.expected: The drawer slides in from the right as a wide panel. The main page is still partially visible.

test_cases.scenario: Import, Export, and Add Financial Year buttons are aligned correctly on desktop
test_cases.steps: 1. View the Financial Years page on a desktop browser.
test_cases.expected: Import, Export, and Add Financial Year buttons are aligned horizontally in the top-right area without overflow.

test_cases.scenario: Secondary columns are hidden on mobile viewports
test_cases.steps: 1. Open the Financial Years page on a mobile viewport (≤ 767px).
test_cases.expected: Short, Code, Start Date, End Date, Span (Days), Active, and Created columns are hidden. Financial Year and Status remain visible.

test_cases.scenario: Add Financial Year drawer is usable on mobile
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer on a mobile device.
2. Fill in Start Date and End Date.
3. Submit.
test_cases.expected: The drawer opens correctly on mobile. All fields are accessible and the financial year is created without layout issues.

test_cases.scenario: Start Date and End Date stack vertically in the create drawer on mobile
test_cases.steps: 1. Open the Add Financial Year drawer on a mobile viewport.
test_cases.expected: Start Date and End Date are stacked vertically (full width each) making them easier to tap on small screens.

test_cases.scenario: View drawer is fully readable on mobile
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap a financial year row on a mobile device to open the view drawer.
test_cases.expected: All fields — Financial Year, Short, Code, Start Date, End Date, Span, Status, Note — are readable without horizontal scrolling.

test_cases.scenario: FY Status and Is Active filters are accessible on mobile
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Financial Years page on a mobile viewport.
2. Tap the Status and Active filters.
test_cases.expected: Both filter dropdowns open and function correctly on mobile.

test_cases.scenario: Delete confirmation modal is usable on mobile
test_cases.steps:
1. On a mobile device, tap Delete for a financial year.
2. Interact with the modal.
test_cases.expected: The confirmation modal displays correctly on mobile. Buttons are tappable and function correctly.

test_cases.scenario: Page header does not overflow on small mobile viewports
test_cases.steps: 1. Open the Financial Years page on a 375px-wide viewport.
test_cases.expected: The title and action buttons do not overflow or overlap.

test_cases.scenario: Financial year set to In Progress is used as the current period in planning views
test_cases.steps:
1. Set a financial year as active (In Progress).
2. Navigate to planning or sprint pages that reference the current financial year.
test_cases.expected: The in-progress financial year is shown as the current period in planning-related views and banners.

test_cases.scenario: Sprints or milestones created within a financial year period are associated correctly
test_cases.steps:
1. Note a financial year's start and end dates.
2. Navigate to the Sprints module and create a sprint that falls within those dates.
test_cases.expected: The sprint is associated with or visible in the context of the relevant financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Financial year code is unique across all records
test_cases.steps:
1. Create two financial year records with overlapping or identical date ranges.
2. Observe the generated codes.
test_cases.expected: Each financial year is assigned a unique auto-generated code. No two financial years share the same code.

test_cases.scenario: FY banner reflects the in-progress financial year
test_cases.steps:
1. Set a financial year as active.
2. View the page header/banner area across different pages of the application.
test_cases.expected: The FY banner or indicator in the application header reflects the currently active (in-progress) financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Financial years are accessible from the Planning section of the navigation
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the main navigation.
2. Navigate to the Planning section.
test_cases.expected: A 'Financial Years' link is present in the Planning section and navigates to the Financial Years page.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated financial years do not interfere with active planning views
test_cases.steps:
1. Deactivate a financial year that is not in progress.
2. Navigate to planning pages.
test_cases.expected: The deactivated financial year is not shown as the current period. Active planning continues with the in-progress financial year.

test_cases.scenario: Deleting a financial year does not affect existing sprint or project associations
test_cases.steps:
1. Identify a financial year associated with existing sprints or projects.
2. Delete it.
3. Navigate to the Sprints or Projects module.
test_cases.expected: Existing sprint or project records are either unaffected or show a clear indication that their associated financial year has been removed.
